**T3.** What it costs to restrict `h` to the affine subgroup. The gap between an exact numerical `h` and an affine one measures how far the realized reparameterization is from affine, and is unaffected by d=1's small pair count in the way a single residual is.

| regime | derived-exact | propagated affine | cost of forcing affine |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| d=1 | 0.0070 | 0.0416 | 5.91× |
| d>=2 | 0.0251 | 0.0245 | 0.98× |
